cultural.vision_reason: The studio portrait shows two Isleta Pueblo men (Alejandro Padilla and Ambrosio Abeita) seated and wearing traditional dress—cloth shirts, jackets, leggings, and patterned blankets around the waist—documenting their attire, alongside three White men in Western suits; this is a documentary photo of Isleta dress.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album; studio portrait of Alejandro Padilla, an Isleta governor, Ambrosio Abeita, an Isleta man, and three White men; Alejandro Padilla is seated on a chair, wearing a cloth shirt, a jacket, leggings, and a patterned blanket around his waist, a hat is on his knee; Ambrosio Abeita is wearing a cloth shirt, a jacket, and a patterned blanket around his waist, a hat is on his knee; the three White men are all wearing three piece suits and bow ties, two are standing and one is seated; Washington DC, United States of America. 
Albumen print
